### Changed
- **Every image default of both charts is a `gsoci.azurecr.io` reference, and `modelServing.imageVerification` defaults to the Giant Swarm signing identity** (giantswarm/agent-platform#575; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37853). The meta chart's kubectl hook images (`gitops.hooks.image`, `gitops.hooks.helmImage`), the bundled Flux engine's operator image (`flux-engine.operator.image`) and the connectivity chart's hook images (`hooks.kubectlImage`, `hooks.opensslImage`) move to their gsoci copies — `giantswarm/kubectl`, `giantswarm/alpine-k8s`, `giantswarm/alpine-openssl` (mirrored by giantswarm/retagger#1228, the same digests as upstream) and `giantswarm/flux-operator` (the Renovate manager that moves the subchart's appVersion with the operator tag names the gsoci image). `modelServing.imageVerification` gains defaults: `images: [gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/*]` and one keyless attestor — issuer `https://oidc.circleci.com`, subject `^https://circleci\.com/api/v2/projects/[a-f0-9-]+/pipeline-definitions/[a-f0-9-]+$` — the identity the architect orb's cosign keyless signing gives every image a Giant Swarm CircleCI project builds or re-signs (the certificate's subject is the pipeline definition that ran; the orb verifies with the same pair), and a new **`type`** (`SigstoreBundle`, the default | `Cosign`): cosign 3 attaches the signature to the image as a Sigstore bundle in an OCI referrer and Kyverno reads one format per rule, so an orb-signed image verified with Kyverno's default `Cosign` type fails with `no signatures found` (`kyverno apply` against a signed gsoci image: `Cosign` fails, `SigstoreBundle` passes with the attestor). The switch stays **off** in the defaults until the curated model images are published and signed (giantswarm/agent-platform#554); the runtime and the llm-d sidecars (the llm-d line signs every mirror and repack since v0.5.0) and every image retagger copies (giantswarm/retagger#1230) already carry the identity. New **`make verify-images`** (in CI through `verify-all`): every container image of every pod template, every `OCIRepository` url and every registry and reference the meta chart forwards in the rendered defaults of both charts — the engine and every component on — is on gsoci; the references whose copies are still being published are tolerated by name with the issue that lands each — the kagent and Substrate lines' charts and images, the CloudNativePG chart and the Flux controllers (giantswarm/agent-platform#580, giantswarm/retagger#1229), the classic runtime's vLLM image (giantswarm/agent-platform#574) — and a stale entry fails the check. The five KServe components (`kserve-crd`, `kserve-resources`, `kserve-llmisvc-crd`, `kserve-llmisvc-resources`, `kserve-runtime-configs`) move to `0.4.x`, the giantswarm/kserve line whose every image default is a gsoci reference (giantswarm/kserve#81: the controllers, `agent`, `router`, `storage-initializer`, the local-model images, `kube-rbac-proxy`; the classic runtimes ship no image any more, which this chart's `servingruntime.enabled: false` never rendered); 0.4.1 is the version the storage-initializer's resources follow `kserve.storage.resources` from (giantswarm/kserve#86) — the BOM example pins it. The connectivity CI fixtures name the gsoci `pgvector` mirror. README: "Verifying the model images". Lab proof (a fresh agentlab on the branch's dev build, Kyverno 1.17.2): `platform-test` all PASS; every hook Job ran from `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/alpine-k8s` / `alpine-openssl` and the Flux operator from gsoci, the only images off gsoci the pending set; the rendered `verifyImages` policy with the defaults admitted the orb-signed `kserve-controller:0.2.4` pinned to its digest (`kyverno.io/verify-images … pass`) and the retagger-signed `kubectl:v1.37.0` likewise, left a `docker.io` image alone (no pattern matches), denied the unsigned `alpine-k8s:1.37.0` and — with the subject pattern swapped for a foreign identity — denied the signed image (`sigstore bundle verification failed: no matching signatures found`). **Installations act**: none for the defaults — a hook Job is created per event, nothing rolls; an installation with `modelServing.imageVerification.enabled: true` and a signer of its own that writes cosign 2's `.sig` tags sets `type: Cosign` (UPGRADE.md).
